name: Mexican-Inspired Rotisserie Chicken Noodle Soup with Veggies (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 stick celery
1 medium zucchini squash
½ lime
½ jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in another medium bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the chicken.

When the veggies have softened, add shredded chicken, zucchini, broth, and pasta to the pot. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a boil. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies and pasta are cooked through, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
7 cups chicken or vegetable broth
3 oz macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, juice lime into a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with oil, sugar, cumin, and salt. Stir to combine the lime mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl with the lime mixture. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the jalapeño-cilantro sauce.

FOR THE KIDS: Fill bowls (about 1 cup each) with chicken noodle soup. Serve with crackers on the side.

FOR THE ADULTS: Divide remaining soup between bowls. Top with jalapeño-cilantro sauce and enjoy!
